fields.statement: QA by hand at af6e4b54 with a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza), in scratch repos with a bare origin and a fake gh on PATH whose pr view reports mergeable CONFLICTING until origin's branch holds main. Rendered-only conflict (both sides appended to .rhiza/rendered/index.md): rhiza ship check --settled printed 'not settled: the pull request conflicted; rebased onto main and pushed 0f55571' and exited 1; origin/cs/ship-it then contained origin/main; .git/rhiza/ship/<cs>.json held pushed = the new origin head; a second --settled --json call reported settled, passed and exited 0. Code conflict (both sides appended to code.txt): it exited 75, printing 'stop: rebasing cs/ship-it onto origin/main conflicts in code.txt; the rebase was aborted; answer question rebase-conflict-ship-it, then resume the run'; --json listed conflicts [code.txt] and question rebase-conflict-ship-it; the only new commit was 'Raise a question on the rebase conflicts', HEAD~1 and origin/cs/ship-it stayed at the pre-check head, the working tree was clean, and a second call exited 75 again without raising a duplicate question.

QA by hand at af6e4b54 with a scratch build, in a scratch repo with RHIZA_* and REX_* unset: a hold workflow with one wait step (until = sh ../cond.sh, interval 50ms), where cond.sh exits 1 on poll 1, on poll 2 prints 'stop: first line' to stdout and 'stop: rebase conflict in code.txt' to stderr and exits 75, then exits 0. rhiza run start --workflow hold logged 'step gate: stopped, rebase conflict in code.txt' after 2 polls; run status showed the run stopped, current step gate, detail 'rebase conflict in code.txt' (the last stop: line, stderr included) and no step outcome. rhiza run resume <run> logged 'continuing visit 1', polled a third time, passed and the run succeeded with gate: pass.
